technology.nri_angle: India's IT services firms have historically been the primary feeder system for Indian tech talent entering the US on H-1B visas. A structural decline in fresher hiring means fewer entry-level engineers gaining the experience that eventually leads to international postings. For NRIs already in the US, it means the next generation of Indian colleagues may look very different — fewer generalists, more AI specialists, and a much smaller pipeline overall.
